documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that Baheti Recycling delivered strong financial performance in FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores. The company is expanding its operations by commencing five new electrical furnaces in FY27 and entering the aluminum wire rod product segment with a phase one capacity of 12,500 metric tons per annum. The management highlighted favorable industry conditions driven by global primary aluminum supply disruptions from Middle Eastern geopolitical tensions, and reported that the company has secured direct orders with auto OEMs like Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, and Royal Enfield. Furthermore, the company is targeting 4-digit revenue in the upcoming financial year while maintaining sustainable EBITDA margins between 7% and 10%. Baheti Recycling reported a strong financial performance for FY26, surpassing its revenue guidance by 12% and achieving higher profit growth.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: The management expects the aluminum wire rod plant utilization to reach around 70% in FY28.
guidance.quote: FY28 will be reaching somewhere around 70-odd percentage.

guidance.claim: The management is hopeful of reaching a 4-digit revenue in this financial year.
guidance.quote: I'm more than hopeful that we'll reach somewhere around 4-digit in this financial alone.

guidance.claim: The company surpassed its stated revenue guidance by 12% and achieved PAT growth over 15% higher than guided for in FY26.
guidance.quote: FY26 has been a good year for us. We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: Management projected revenue potential between ₹200-250 Crores annually from Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division at 12,500 MT capacity.
guidance.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

guidance.claim: The company stated that scaling to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 will bring the annual revenue potential from the Aluminium Wire Rod division to ₹500 Crores.
guidance.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

guidance.claim: Management stated a target to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for secondary recycling aluminum is supported by government policy tailwinds and global industry dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stood at over ₹175 Crores at the start of Q1 FY27, reflecting steady domestic demand for secondary aluminium.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, and Bajaj Auto have been added as direct OEM supply clients for automotive requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: This year, we added some clients we are genuinely proud of - TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, Bajaj Auto- all of whom are now being supplied directly for their automotive requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant targets around 12,500 metric tons per annum with an annual revenue potential of 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

capex_expansion.claim: In phase 2, the wire rod capacity will increase to 25,000 tons, increasing total revenue from the plant to around 500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20-25 Crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for commissioning in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to be operational by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets a capacity of 12,500 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Machinery cost for the wire rod expansion is estimated at ₹5-6 crore on existing freehold spare land.
capex_expansion.quote: The company benefits from owned freehold land and minimal incremental capital expenditure with an estimated machinery cost of ₹5–6 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The aluminum wire rod product segment is a higher margin product segment.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond our core alloy and deoxidant line, we are now entering into aluminum wire rod product, which is a higher margin product segment.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin of the wire rod division will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel prices caused the cost of production to increase by 15%.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The operation of the captive solar plant will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces, with margin benefits starting from Q2 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

orders_capacity.claim: With the addition of 5 new electrical furnaces, the total installed capacity will stand at 38,000 tons annually.
orders_capacity.quote: With this addition, our total installed capacity will stand to 38,000 tons annually.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity utilization is 60%.
The company is heading into FY27 with an order book of minimum 200 crores, excluding the aluminum wire rod plant.
orders_capacity.quote: We are heading into FY27 with an order of Minimum 200 crores with us. And there are a lot of excitement development. This is excluding order book or the plant of aluminum wire rod.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, and Bajaj Auto as clients, supplying them directly for automotive requirements.
orders_capacity.quote: This year, we added some clients we are genuinely proud of - TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, Bajaj Auto- all of whom are now being supplied directly for their automotive requirements.

orders_capacity.claim: Total smelting capacity reached 38,000 MT following the replacement of older pit furnaces with electric furnaces.
orders_capacity.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Total production capacity reached 38,000 MT in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively focused on reducing debt and improving key financial ratios.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, company’s actively focused on Reducing the debt and improving the key financial ratio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to maintain healthy working capital as volumes grow.
capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East tightened primary aluminium supply globally and created pressure on availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.
